<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 4"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Air Shroud](/Feats.aspx?ID=4210) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Air" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=5" />
<trait label="Impulse" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=502" />
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
<trait label="Stance" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=152" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 24

</column>

---

Turbulent air suffuses your kinetic aura. This doesn't displace other matter but provides air for creatures in your kinetic aura that need air to breathe. Attacks with ranged weapons take a –1 circumstance penalty to their attack rolls if their paths pass through your kinetic aura. Air in your kinetic aura is [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=453) for flying creatures other than yourself.
name: Air Shroud
